question: What are the exact small-prime iid mixing times and fixed-hash first-repeat distributions for every registered support/map, and do independent exact implementations and actual Lean boundary controls agree?

claims.text: An actual four-step PMF has a fixed-support nonmixing witness for6t+2≤p, including prime101,t10. Decided by Lean, not this census.
Actual normalized Z/3 hash-graph in-degree variance is1/2 for two distinct nonzero steps, rather than the literal printed reciprocal2. Decided by Lean.
Every registered finite population is enumerated and the inline independent matrix/Floyd/mass/variance checks and deterministic repeats agree; censored mixing cells remain explicit.
Hildebrand random-support asymptotics, nonuniform p_i penalties, limiting collision constants, practical hash functions and overall DLP security are outside this finite decision.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Embedded mathematical known answers and two independent algorithms per task replace a statistical detector; preflight p3mix and p2rho pass, full-support p3rho has a prescribed mapping control.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No sampled population or null-hypothesis inference. Every registered support/map is included; no statistical unusualness or scaling claim.

decision_rule.text: finite_checks_pass only if both complete populations and all checks/repeats pass. Censored supports remain reported, not hidden. Any check failure is invalid/error, never repaired under this version. Finite values do not decide source asymptotics.
decision_rule.statistic: exact polynomial/integer/rational identities, complete population counts and deterministic byte agreement
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: exact finite mixing steps and collision/variance/baseline fractions; no population inference

inputs: fixed populations embedded in frozen source

inadmissible: Calling disclosed preflight probes confirmatory or out-of-sample.
Changing source, support population, cap, strata, verifier or analysis after affected data without a new labelled version.
Inferring asymptotic failure or nonuniform p_i conclusions from these finite equal-label populations.
Conflating iid terminal mixing with fixed-hash first collisions.
Claiming clock speed, independent machine, signed promotion or generic implementation theorem.
